<a id="Make.impl.execShown"></a>

### Method `execShown`

```silk
pub effect fn execShown(
    self: &mut Self,
    program: &Deferred<Path>,
    arguments: &[string],
  ) -> i32
    ! StepFailure
    ? &mut Allocator
```

Executes a declared program as [`Make.exec`](#Make.impl.exec) does, with the program's standard error on this
process's own, so what it writes, such as live progress, shows while it runs. Answers the
program's exit status (0 on success, 128 plus the signal number after a signal, or 1 when no
status was reported). Where children cannot share the stream, the errors show once it ends.

The caller must include both executables' content digests in `identity`.

Limits the number of worker fibers; zero selects one worker.

<a id="Runner.impl.execute"></a>

### Method `execute`

```silk
pub effect fn execute(self: &Self, targets: &[StepHandle], compile: bool) -> Execution
    ! StepFailure | SpawnError | Cancelled
    ? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem | &mut HostInput
```

Resolves each key before running its step, executing prerequisites needed to discover file sets.
Only requested steps and their declared inputs run.
When `compile` is false, requested compilations write requests while prerequisite tools build.
